tools.description: Universal Ctags - advanced source code indexer supporting 50+ languages
tools.usage:
ctags -R . # Generate tags for entire project
ctags --languages=Python,JavaScript src/ # Specific languages
ctags --extras=+r --fields=+l *.c # Enhanced tags with references
ctags --list-languages # Show supported languages

tools.description: Universal Ctags tag file reader with powerful filtering and formatting
tools.usage:
readtags -t tags function_name # Find specific tag
readtags -l # List all tags
readtags -Q '(eq? $kind "function")' -l # Filter by kind
readtags -S -l # Sort tags
